title: From Analogue to Calibration: SAT Geometry How-To
summary: A reproducible SAT/H(s)H geometry workflow developed from a hand sketch through explicit 3D construction, arclength accounting, recursive wrapping, same-path-speed constraints, inverse winding-density calculation, and strict separation of model geometry from display transforms. The useful result is the method and its documented failed passes, not a promoted physical claim.

public_copy.headline: From sketch to calculation without letting the picture rewrite the model
public_copy.dek: A worked SAT/H(s)H solver lesson: preserve the analogue, construct the geometry explicitly, measure the paths, calibrate independently, and only then render it.
public_copy.note: Includes the failed visual passes because the failures are part of the reproducible method.
